List.description: A controlled list's selected row and keyboard pane, on the entity its consumer names.

cursor.description: The selected row's eid in the consumer's graph, not a local reference.

pane.description: The pane holding the keyboard, never a layout switch.

Panels.description: The open panel and its tab, on the page's named panel-manager entity.

panel.description: The open panel's eid; absent when all panels are closed.

pane.description: The tab the panel's consumer draws, if it has tabs.

Panel.description: A panel heading on its named page entity.

head.description: The panel heading supplied by its consumer.

Tab.description: A tab notification mark on its named page entity.

marked.description: Whether this tab has something new to show.
